lines.text: A maintenance book, pencil and cold mug occupy the caretaker’s desk. The last entry records a leaking gutter over the rehearsal range.
(again) The book is still open at the gutter repair.
A folding table, clean linen and the old baths service pipes share the room. The valves have their positions written on the service sheet.
(again) The service sheet identifies the old baths circuit.
Flight cases, dismantled stands and paper wrapping have been sorted onto racks. A hand truck stands beside the open packing bench.
(again) The packing list is held down by a length of cloth tape.
